notes.title: THEY'RE HERE! 😱
notes.content: [h3]Are you ready for [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553320/Them/"]THEM[/url][/b]?! 😱[/h3][p]My new game is now available on Steam 🔥 It's a combination of a first-person psychological experience and a 2D platformer. I would be happy if you try it out and share your thoughts about it.[/p][p]Let's play a different game together... 🎮😰[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42935968/9c006c731e8a33cea6b150b80894eeca91901e25.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553320/Them/"][/dynamiclink][/h2]

notes.title: Update 0.46 is available! 😱
notes.content:
Hi Guys! As I promised, Update 4.6 is ready and you can now get this update 😱
Here you can see the list of added features in this update.

[list]
[b][*] Story Chapter 4 unlocked!
[*] New Challenge Mod
[*] Six New Achievements
[*] Xbox controllers support
[*] Ukrainian Language (UI+Subtitle)
[*] Some minor bugs fixed[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42935968/707456c9f1cb9e1d76aba3fc69d54a8ff27f17d2.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates! 😁 I am trying to add more features to the game (Story Chapters, New Challenges, Puzzles...) Maybe you'll find it exciting. I'm looking forward to your comments.

notes.title: Update 0.452
notes.content:
Hi guys, as promised, the new update is ready! we have added some of the features you requested in this update 😉✌️ Thank you for supporting us 🙏

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42935968/d7c17be2958b66e15f9c5dcc80ec551e97e62448.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]4 New Languages added (Turkish, Russian, Chinese, Korean)[/b]
[*] [b]Achievements now available on easy mod[/b]
[*] [b]Game volume slider added to game settings[/b]
[*] [b]Reset Default controller button added to game settings[/b]
[*] [b]Customization keyboard problem fixed[/b]
[*] [b]Pills collected save system added[/b]
[*] [b]Weapon Reload system is faster now[/b]
[*] [b]Loading freezing problem fixed[/b]
[/list]
